intro: GTA 6 launches on Thursday 19 November 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It unlocks at midnight local time, country by country, so the launch rolls around the world over about 19 hours.

notes: Online: Rockstar describes GTA 6 as a single-player experience. No online mode has been announced, and dates you see elsewhere are rumours.
PC: no date or window yet. GTA V took about 18 months to reach PC; PC Gamer's best guess is not before November 2027.
Playing early: some players switch to a New Zealand account or region. On PlayStation that needs a separate NZ account and a copy bought from that store.
